newsitem.title: DENMARK: Tele Danmark buys entertainment producer.
newsitem.headline: Tele Danmark buys entertainment producer.

text.p: Danish telecommunications group Tele Danmark A/S said on Friday that with Norway's Schibsted it had bought Danish company Metronome's film, music and video production business for an undisclosed sum.

"Given the expected growth in demand for entertainment, education and information services in the home, it is Tele Danmark's intention to become actively involved in more aspects of production," the Danish operator said in a statement.
Tele Danmark's cable television has an estimated 740,000 subscribers in Denmark with an annual turnover of 400 million crowns ($68.8 million), about two percent of the group's total annual revenue.
The deal gives Tele Danmark 75 percent of Metronome's video distribution, music business, television studios and multi-media and film products and 25 percent of its film and TV production.
The statement said that Schibsted would hold the remaining 25 and 75 percent stakes in the two operations respectively.
Metronome's turnover in 1995 was approximately 280 million crowns. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652 ($ = 5.813 Danish Crowns)
